title: Phase 1 Validation: Reorder Without Duplicates
description:
Verify queue reordering works without creating duplicates.

Test steps:
1. Add 3+ items to Brief queue
2. Reorder items via drag-and-drop
3. Verify no duplicates appear
4. Verify playback index stays sane (current item still highlighted)

Expected: Single source of truth (QueueCoordinator) prevents duplicate mutations.
